returned.text: {"question_target":null,"reply":"Medicare is federal health insurance, and at a high level you have two main ways to get it. You can get Original Medicare, which is Parts A and B through the federal program, or Medicare Advantage, which is a private plan approved by Medicare that provides Parts A and B instead. With Original Medicare, you can add a separate drug plan and may be able to buy Medigap to help with your share of costs; with Medicare Advantage, most plans include drug coverage.
